title: 说说昨天做了什么
goal: 能用几句简单的话说出昨天或者周末做了什么。

chunks.note: 问过去的事用 did。回答时动词要换成"过去的样子"。

chunks.en: I had dinner with my family.

chunks.note: 很多动词后面加 ed 就是过去：stay → stayed。
am / is 的过去是 was。

chunks.en: Last weekend, I went to the park.
chunks.note: last weekend = 上周末，last night = 昨晚。

frames.usage: 问别人已经做过的事：吃了什么、买了什么、说了什么。有 did，后面的动作不用变，照常说 eat、buy、say。
说自己昨天做了什么。___ 里的动作要换成"过去的样子"：go → went，buy → bought，call → called。

examples.scene: 朋友说昨天去了 hawker centre，你问她吃了什么。
老公提着好几个 NTUC 袋子回到家，你好奇地问。
在 hawker centre 太吵了，你没听清朋友刚才说什么。
家长说没收到补课通知，你告诉他昨天给他打过电话。
town council 打电话说你家还没交费，你说昨天已经付了。
妈妈打电话来，问你昨天吃了什么。
学生下课出来，你在前台笑着问他今天学了什么。
老板问你昨天为什么没来上班。
examples.en: I went to the doctor yesterday.
examples.note: go to the doctor = 去看医生；went = go 的过去

examples.scene: 邻居看到你换了手机，问你什么时候买的。
examples.en: I bought a new phone yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天买了一部新手机。

examples.scene: 星期一早上，你问刚到的同事周末做了什么。
examples.en: What did you do last weekend?

daily.scene: 早上在电梯里，邻居问你昨晚睡得好不好。
早上家人说你看起来很累。
回到家，你跟老公说在巴刹遇到了陈太太。
daily.en: I saw Mrs Tan at the market.
daily.zh: 我在巴刹看到陈太太了。

daily.scene: 家人问你怎么这么久才上来，你说在电梯里遇到了邻居。
daily.en: I met my neighbour in the lift.
daily.zh: 我在电梯里遇到了邻居。

daily.scene: 星期天晚上，朋友打电话问你今天做了什么。
老公问车怎么这么干净。
朋友看到你提着商场的袋子。
昨天下大雨，朋友问你是怎么回家的。
daily.note: took = take 的过去；take the MRT = 坐地铁

daily.scene: 邻居问你周末带孩子去哪里了。
daily.en: My son played at the park.
I bought it a week ago.
daily.note: a week ago = 一个星期前

daily.scene: 邻居问你星期六去哪里了。
daily.en: I went shopping with my friend.
daily.note: go shopping = 去逛街、去买东西

daily.scene: 朋友问你周末为什么没去公园。

lines.en: Last Sunday was a busy day.
I cleaned the house in the morning.
After that, I went to the market.
I saw Mrs Tan at the market.
lines.zh: 我在巴刹看到了陈太太。

lines.en: I bought some fish and eggs.
It rained all afternoon.
I stayed at home and watched TV.
My husband washed the car.
I cooked dinner for my family.
We had dinner together.
I was very tired.
I slept very well that night.

dialogue.title: 星期一早上的电梯
dialogue.setting: 星期一早上，Amy 在 HDB 电梯里遇到邻居陈太太。

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: Morning, Amy! How was your weekend?
lines.zh: 早上好，Amy！周末过得怎么样？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: It was good, thank you.

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: What did you do?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I went shopping with my friend.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I bought some new clothes.

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: Nice! I saw you at the market yesterday.
lines.zh: 真好！我昨天在巴刹看到你了。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes! What did you buy?

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: I bought some fish. What did you cook?
lines.zh: 我买了一些鱼。你做了什么菜？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I cooked chicken rice for my family.

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: Very good! Are you tired today?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes, I slept late last night.

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: Sleep early tonight!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I will. Have a nice day, Mrs Tan!
lines.zh: 会的。祝你今天愉快，陈太太！

grammar.title: 说过去的事，动词要变
grammar.body: 中文说"昨天去""今天去"，"去"字不变；英语说过去的事，动词要换成过去的样子。大多数动词后面加 ed（cook → cooked）。最常用的几个要单独记：go → went，have → had，do → did，am / is → was。

examples.en: Today I go to work. Yesterday I went to work.
examples.zh: 今天我去上班。昨天我去上班了。

examples.en: Today I cook. Yesterday I cooked.
examples.zh: 今天我做饭。昨天我做了饭。

examples.en: I am tired. I was tired yesterday.

dialogue.title: 周一早上聊周末
dialogue.setting: 星期一早上，同事 Mei Ling 问你周末过得怎么样。

npc.en: Morning, Amy! How was your weekend?
npc.zh: 早上好，Amy！周末过得怎么样？

replies.en: I went to the park yesterday.
I stayed at home and watched TV.

npc.zh: 听起来不错。你做饭了吗？

npc.en: Me, I was so busy on Saturday!

replies.en: Oh, really? What did you do?

npc.en: I took my son to his swimming class, then I went shopping.
npc.zh: 我带儿子去上游泳课，然后又去逛街。

replies.en: Oh, it was a busy day!

npc.en: Yes! OK, let's start work. Have a good day!
npc.zh: 是啊！好了，开始干活吧。祝你今天顺利！

task: 今天用英语说三句昨天做了什么，比如 Yesterday, I went to work. 说给自己或者家人听。
